en.sayed-ali-raza: Therefore, hasten with your ears towards it and intensify your efforts for it.
Make it a substitute for all your past (shortcomings) to take their place as a successor, and make it your supporter against every opponent.

Turn your sleep into wakefulness by its help, and pass your days with it. Make it the equipment of your hearts, wash your sins with it, treat your ailments with it and hasten towards your death with it.
Take a lesson from him who neglects it, so that others who follow it should not take a lesson from you (i.e., from your neglecting it).
Beware, therefore; you should take care of it and should take care of yourselves through it.
